title: System Prompt Robustness: Do Safety System Prompts Hold Against In-Context Override Attacks?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly addresses the lab-to-deployment gap: deployed models use system prompts as a primary safety mechanism. If system prompt safety is easily overridden, the entire operator safety model is compromised. Clear actionable chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing system prompt variants and override attacks is primarily prompt engineering -- well within CS student capabilities. No training or specialized ML knowledge needed. Running inference on 3 models via API is straightforward.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 4 system prompt variants x 5 attack strategies x 3 models = 60 conditions. Each needs multiple test prompts. The matrix is well-defined but large. Could be scoped to 3x3x2 to fit 30 hours.
